{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Load the data
sales = pd.read_csv('data/sales.csv')

# Inspect the raw 'revenue' strings for the 6 problematic rows
invalid_revenue_completed = sales[(sales['status'] == 'completed') & (sales['revenue'].isna())]

# Extract the raw 'revenue' strings for these rows
raw_revenue_values = invalid_revenue_completed['revenue'].values
print("Raw revenue strings for the 6 invalid rows:", raw_revenue_values)

# Check for any leading/trailing whitespace
print("Are there any leading/trailing spaces?", any(' ' in val or '\t' in val or '\n' in val for val in raw_revenue_values))

# Check for any non-ASCII characters
print("Any non-ASCII characters?", any(not val.isascii() for val in raw_revenue_values))

# Try to manually inspect one
print("First example:", raw_revenue_values[0])"}
